newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Battered banking shares pull Prague bourse lower.
newsitem.headline: Battered banking shares pull Prague bourse lower.

text.p: Several Czech blue chip shares posted losses on the Prague Stock Exchange on Friday, as banking issues continue to suffer from the fallout of central bank intervention at Agrobanka.

Komercni Banka, Ceska Sporitelna, Zivnostenska Banka all lost ground to push the PX50 index down three points, or 0.53 percent, to 565.8 while the Reuters real-time RPIX index fell nine points points to 1,145.
On Tuesday the CNB placed Agrobanka under temporary forced administration after with liquidity problems arising from the failure of Kreditni Banka.
Other financial institutions such as Ceska Poijistovna, which have been connected in some way to investment group Motoinvest linked to Kreditni Banka, also suffered losses.
Agrobanka shares fell the maximum allowed five percent for the fifth consecutive session, down 4.58 crowns to 87.09.
SPT Telecom, the bourse's most heavily-capitalised issue, was one of the few blue chip bright spots, rising 25 crowns to 3,360.
Overall volume was moderate with 780,143 shares changing hands on turnover of 637 million crowns.
